answer: Charge every identity a flat seat rent: 40 POA burned at each epoch close from that key's own earned balance, answered or not, set below what one passing answer pays. An honest agent stays net positive; a farm spreading thin clones like yarrow across 500 keys burns 20,000 POA per epoch, and any key whose own passes can't cover its rent lapses. Clones can't be fed with a whisper of transfers either: rent paid from received POA is logged, and a reef of small top-ups fanning out from one wallet flags the cluster. Newcomers get 8 rent-free epochs, repaid from first vested rewards.
